db:select.db:sql: select loan_id, customer_id, loan_amount, interest_rate, tenure_months, emi_amount, outstanding_amount, loan_status, approval_date from loan where loan_number = :loanNumber;

logger.message: loan found. Proceeding with payment processing.

db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO loan_payment ( loan_id, installment_number, payment_date, due_date, amount_paid, principal_amount, interest_amount, payment_mode, payment_status, transaction_reference, created_date ) VALUES ( :loan_id, :installment_number, :payment_date, :due_date, :amount_paid, :principal_amount, :interest_amount, :payment_mode, :payment_status, :transaction_reference, :created_date );

db:update.db:sql: UPDATE loan SET outstanding_amount = outstanding_amount - :amountPaid WHERE loan_id = :loanId;
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { amountPaid: vars.paymentRecord.amount_paid, loanId: vars.paymentRecord.loan_id }]

db:select.db:sql: SELECT lp.payment_id, l.loan_number, lp.installment_number, lp.payment_date, lp.due_date, lp.amount_paid, lp.principal_amount, lp.interest_amount, lp.payment_mode, lp.payment_status, lp.transaction_reference, lp.created_date FROM loan_payment lp JOIN loan l ON lp.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE lp.transaction_reference = :transactionReference;

SELECT lp.payment_id, l.loan_number, lp.installment_number, lp.payment_date, lp.due_date, lp.amount_paid, lp.principal_amount, lp.interest_amount, lp.payment_mode, lp.payment_status, lp.transaction_reference, lp.created_date FROM loan_payment lp JOIN loan l ON lp.loan_id = l.loan_id ORDER BY lp.payment_id;

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map (payment) -> { payment_id: payment.payment_id, loan_number: payment.loan_number, installment_number: payment.installment_number, payment_date: payment.payment_date, due_date: payment.due_date, amount_paid: payment.amount_paid, principal_amount: payment.principal_amount, interest_amount: payment.interest_amount, payment_mode: payment.payment_mode, payment_status: payment.payment_status, transaction_reference: payment.transaction_reference, created_date: payment.created_date }

db:select.db:sql: SELECT lp.payment_id, l.loan_number, lp.installment_number, lp.payment_date, lp.due_date, lp.amount_paid, lp.principal_amount, lp.interest_amount, lp.payment_mode, lp.payment_status, lp.transaction_reference, lp.created_date FROM loan_payment lp JOIN loan l ON lp.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE lp.payment_id = :paymentId;
